title: Federal Register (federalregister.gov API)
agency: Office of the Federal Register, National Archives and Records Administration
questions: how many executive orders did each president sign
final rules published by EPA each year
proposed rules with comment periods closing soon

manual.how: Open the JSON links in INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser and save each page; or run the same search on https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/search, choose 'CSV' or 'JSON' under the results (the export button), and upload the file. Replace '/documents.json' with '/documents.csv' in a link for a CSV of the same query.

cache.why: New documents publish every business day; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: Federal Register documents and their metadata are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105). The website's text is not the official legal edition; the official edition is the PDF on govinfo.gov.

notices: Federal Register metadata from federalregister.gov, which is not the official legal edition of the Federal Register; the official edition is published by the Government Publishing Office on govinfo.gov.
citation: Office of the Federal Register (NARA), Federal Register API, {dataset}, federalregister.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which document types count: final rules only (RULE), proposed rules (PRORULE), notices, or presidential documents? Default: final rules.
Publication date or signing/effective date? Counts by year use publication date unless asked otherwise.

Leave out correction notices? Default: in counts compared with OFR's statistics, keep them (OFR counts corrections within each type); in lists of documents, leave them out (conditions[correction]=0, the documents default).
